notes:
- The detail sheet scrolls from its own picture: Dragging down on the artwork at the top of a title's details did nothing at all, and on a hard fling it looked like the picture bouncing twice. The artwork's pan gesture was gated on 'is there anywhere to drag to', which asks whether the image overflows its box on either side - and the cover fit always overflows on one of them, so the answer was always yes. The gate then took every vertical swipe aimed at the artwork, including the ones meant to scroll the sheet, and snapped it back to where it started. It now steps aside until you pinch to zoom, so the sheet scrolls normally from the top. You can no longer drag the banner sideways at rest to see its cropped edges; pinch first and dragging comes back.
- Switching tabs no longer throws your edit away: Moving between a title's tabs and coming back to 'My Entry' blanked the form, showed the loading spinner again, and fetched your entry from AniList a second time - every single time. The tabs swap by animating, and the one being animated away is thrown away with anything it remembered, so the half-finished edit went with it.
